summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Babel plugin (linaria CSS-to-undefined transform) impersonating the ornikar-scoped project by Christophe Hurpeau, but its package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is hex-identifier-obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, dispatcher objects) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts the platform-specific binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bunBinary, ['math_init.js'])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle with shuffled string arrays (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, `function WV8StW(...) { for(...) MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()); return MmgoCP }`) and randomized identifiers, unrelated to the Babel-plugin functionality shipped in `lib/index.js`. A Babel AST transform has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a 700KB obfuscated payload; the `math_init.js` filename is cover-story naming. The alternate-runtime execution pattern bypasses Node-focused install scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
